CVE-2026-53914 affects unsafe deserialization of KAPT incremental build cache metadata. kotlin-stdlib 2.4.0, included through webp-imageio 0.11.0, contains none of the affected KAPT classes. This checkout has no KAPT tasks or configurations; the Kotlin Gradle plugin API used by AspectJ does not enable KAPT. The generic jetbrains:kotlin CPE incorrectly associates this CVE with the stdlib. This is a false-positive suppression, not a mitigation or accepted residual risk. Reassess when the artifact version/content changes or KAPT is introduced, and evaluate any Kotlin build tooling separately from this standard-library artifact. Verified on 2026-10-11 against the resolved JAR and Gradle dependency/task graph. References: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/commit/bf51df665b458fda7c3eaf436c4d88dc119d7ec6

CVE-2022-37830 affects stored XSS in the media editor of WebJET CMS before 8.6.896. WebJET AI and WebJET AI Local are separate Java AI libraries, not WebJET CMS releases. Their resolved 2.0.4 JARs do not contain the CMS media editor or MediaDataController. The webjet:webjet_cms CPE is a product mismatch. This rule suppresses only this CVE on these two AI artifacts; it does not suppress findings on WebJET CMS or assert that the CMS media editor is safe. Reassess when the artifact version/content changes or the advisory scope changes. Verified on 2026-10-11 against both resolved JARs and their Maven metadata. References: https://citadelo.com/download/CVE-2022-37830.pdf https://github.com/webjetcms/webjet-ai
